evidence.detail: HEAD and the launcher target both resolve to 451dbe236769760c2384ab3f198c1f5b11f7c1ae; the worktree was clean.

The exact base-to-target diff modifies README.md, web/index.html, web/app.js, web/style.css, tests/test_ui_safety.py, and issue governance/evidence records. Product-source changes remain within the roadmap's allowed product paths.

The repair places secret-field clearing in a finally block around POST /api/auth/app, covering resolved and rejected requests. Static inspection found no console, web-storage, cookie, URL, query-string, dangerous HTML sink, external-asset, or CSP relaxation regression.
The focused UI safety suite independently passed: 16 tests, exit 0.
The full suite ran 173 tests but exited 1 with 68 errors because the read-only sandbox denied loopback socket binding with PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted.
The compile check exited 1 because the read-only sandbox denied creation of __pycache__.
The governance validator exited 1 because no writable temporary directory was available to its launcher smoke tests.

The handoff records author-run results of 173 passing tests, successful compilation and validation, plus a human-performed browser walkthrough covering mode switching, failed submit, mocked successful submit, and logout. These are relevant committed claims but do not replace independent execution evidence.

evidence: Expected: project/status/CURRENT.md must be an accurate repository-only index of the current gate, reviewed candidate, blockers, and next permitted action.

Observed: the candidate and issue record identify repair round 1 after the round-0 review, but CURRENT.md repeatedly says round 0 is awaiting its first review, says no repair round is open, reports 172 rather than 173 tests, and directs the launcher to review the obsolete round-0 candidate.
A fresh task following CURRENT.md would reconstruct the wrong review iteration and could invoke the wrong next action.
findings.remediation: Update CURRENT.md consistently to identify repair round 1, target commit 451dbe236769760c2384ab3f198c1f5b11f7c1ae, the recorded round-0 review, 173-test author evidence, and the correct round-1 review action. Because this changes committed review metadata, run a fresh review against the resulting candidate SHA.
findings.title: Current-state index still describes the obsolete round-0 candidate
findings.verification: From a fresh checkout, compare every CURRENT.md round, candidate, review, check-count, actor, and next-action field with project/issues/ISSUE-0010.md and project/handoffs/ISSUE-0010-handoff.md; then run the governance validator and launch a fresh commit-bound review.

limitations: Independent required execution evidence is incomplete: the full unit suite, py_compile, and governance validator could not pass in this read-only sandbox for environmental reasons. Under the repository review rules and launcher binding, this requires BLOCKED even though the focused UI suite passed and the failures do not indicate a candidate-code defect.

The browser walkthrough was human-performed and partly used an uncommitted local mock-success helper. Its recorded observations and setup cannot be independently reproduced from this isolated checkout.
No live Entra authentication or Microsoft Graph request was performed; this is explicitly outside the issue completion requirements and requires separate protected-action approval.
The checkout is shallow/grafted, but both supplied commit objects were available and the exact base-to-target diff was inspectable.
review.summary: BLOCKED. The app-only UI repair appears technically sound under static review, the focused 16-test UI safety suite passes, and the rejected-fetch clearing defect is fixed. However, the mandatory full checks could not be independently completed in the read-only sandbox, and CURRENT.md materially misidentifies this repair-round-1 candidate as the initial round-0 review.
